opportunities.title: Video Animado entrega 3 días
opportunities.description: BRIEF TÉCNICO DE PRODUCCIÓN AUDIOVISUAL Cliente: Priscila Bethancourt. Tipo de proyecto: Producción audiovisual explicativa, académica e institucional. 1. OBJETIVO DEL PROYECTO Producir un video resumen de una investigación universitaria sobre las alertas meteorológicas en a. El objetivo es transformar el contenido de la investigación en una pieza audiovisual dinámica, visualmente atractiva y fácil de comprender, que mantenga la atención de los espectadores y permita explicar los principales conceptos, datos y conclusiones del trabajo. No se busca una presentación convencional de diapositivas, sino una producción audiovisual con recursos gráficos, animaciones, infografías y material visual de apoyo. 2. MATERIALES PROPORCIONADOS POR LA CLIENTE La cliente compartió una carpeta de Google Drive con el material de producción: Según lo indicado por la cliente, contiene: 1. Guion: estructura y contenido narrativo del video. 2. Storyboard: referencia visual de las escenas y los elementos que podrían acompañar cada fragmento de la locución. 3. Locución: narración de voz en off que servirá como base para organizar y sincronizar el video. 4. Clips audiovisuales: videos que pueden utilizarse como material complementario en determinadas escenas. 5. Logotipos: recursos de identidad visual para incorporar donde corresponda. La cliente confirma que el storyboard es orientativo y que no es obligatorio reproducir exactamente sus indicaciones. Existe libertad creativa para proponer soluciones visuales que mejoren el resultado. Antes de comenzar: revisar todos los archivos de la carpeta, escuchar la locución completa y estudiar el guion y storyboard. 3. DIRECCIÓN CREATIVA Y ESTILO VISUAL La cliente quiere un video dinámico que mantenga la atención de los espectadores. Se recomienda una estética: - Profesional, moderna e institucional. - Académica, pero visualmente atractiva. - Limpia y organizada. - Con buena jerarquía visual. - Con transiciones fluidas y movimientos naturales. - Con variedad de recursos gráficos para evitar escenas estáticas prolongadas. Se pueden combinar infografías animadas, ilustraciones, mapas, estadísticas, textos, iconos, imágenes y clips reales. La animación debe cumplir una función explicativa, no utilizarse únicamente como decoración. 4. RECURSOS VISUALES QUE DEBE INCLUIR LA PRODUCCIÓN A. Infografías y estadísticas - Representación visual de datos relevantes de la investigación. - Gráficos animados y elementos estadísticos. - Diagramas y esquemas explicativos. - Cifras y conceptos destacados en pantalla. B. Mapas y elementos meteorológicos - Mapas de República Dominicana cuando corresponda. - Representaciones visuales de alertas meteorológicas. - Iconografía relacionada con el clima y los fenómenos meteorológicos. - Elementos gráficos que ayuden a explicar la información geográfica. C. Textos y títulos - Títulos animados. - Palabras clave destacadas. - Textos explicativos breves. - Subtítulos sincronizados con la narración. D. Animaciones y transiciones - Movimientos gráficos fluidos. - Transiciones profesionales. - Animación de elementos visuales. - Composiciones dinámicas que acompañen la explicación. E. Clips y recursos audiovisuales - Aprovechar los videos proporcionados por la cliente cuando sean relevantes. - Incorporar los logotipos suministrados. - Combinar material real con recursos gráficos para enriquecer la narrativa. 5. ESTRUCTURA NARRATIVA La producción debe seguir el guion y la locución proporcionados por la cliente. Como referencia, la narrativa contempla: 1. Introducción y presentación del tema. 2. Contexto de las alertas meteorológicas en República Dominicana. 3. Desarrollo de los aspectos principales de la investigación. 4. Presentación de datos y hallazgos relevantes. 5. Conclusiones y cierre. El orden definitivo debe respetar el guion entregado. No agregar información, estadísticas ni conclusiones que no estén respaldadas por el material de la investigación. 6. AUDIO Y LOCUCIÓN - Utilizar la locución proporcionada por la cliente. - Sincronizar las escenas y animaciones con la narración. - Incorporar música de fondo apropiada para una producción académica e institucional. - Realizar mezcla y nivelación de audio. - Mantener la voz clara y por encima de la música. - Incorporar efectos sonoros sutiles cuando aporten valor. La locución será la guía principal para establecer el ritmo y la duración de las escenas. 7. ESPECIFICACIONES TÉCNICAS - Duración estimada: 2 minutos y 30 segundos a 3 minutos y 30 segundos. - Orientación: horizontal 16:9. - Resolución: 1920 × 1080 píxeles. - Calidad: Full HD. - Formato de entrega: MP4. - Audio: locución, música y mezcla. - Textos: títulos y subtítulos integrados. La duración debe ajustarse al contenido real de la locución y al guion aprobado. 8. ENTREGABLE FINAL Se debe entregar: 1. Video completo en formato MP4 y resolución Full HD. 2. Todas las escenas editadas y ensambladas. 3. Recursos gráficos, infografías y animaciones integrados. 4. Locución sincronizada. 5. Música de fondo y mezcla de audio. 6. Subtítulos integrados. 7. Transiciones y acabado audiovisual profesional. 9. RONDAS DE CORRECCIONES El proyecto contempla dos rondas de ajustes gratuitos: Primera ronda: correcciones generales de textos, escenas, sincronización, gráficos y detalles visuales. Segunda ronda: aplicación de observaciones finales y refinamiento de los elementos previamente corregidos. Las correcciones deben mantenerse dentro del guion, storyboard y alcance acordados. Los cambios sustanciales de concepto, nuevas secciones o ampliaciones importantes del contenido quedan fuera de las revisiones ordinarias. 10. CRITERIOS DE CALIDAD El resultado debe cumplir con lo siguiente: - Mantener la atención del espectador. - Tener una narrativa visual coherente. - Evitar escenas excesivamente estáticas. - Presentar datos e infografías fáciles de comprender. - Utilizar animaciones que refuercen la explicación. - Mantener consistencia gráfica durante todo el video. - Respetar el contenido académico de la investigación. - Garantizar buena sincronización entre imagen y locución. - Tener un acabado profesional apropiado para una presentación universitaria. INSTRUCCIÓN GENERAL PARA EL EDITOR La prioridad es convertir el guion, storyboard y locución de la cliente en un video explicativo de calidad profesional. La cliente no ha establecido ningún software ni técnica de producción obligatoria. El editor tiene libertad para seleccionar las herramientas y los métodos de trabajo que considere más adecuados, siempre que se respete el resultado visual solicitado. Se recomienda dar protagonismo a las infografías, mapas, estadísticas y elementos animados, combinándolos con clips reales y otros recursos visuales cuando corresponda. Importante: no comenzar a producir escenas aisladas sin revisar primero la totalidad de la locución y el storyboard. Es necesario organizar la secuencia completa, identificar qué recurso visual acompañará cada fragmento de audio y mantener una continuidad narrativa de principio a fin.

raw_data.verbatim_request: "BRIEF TÉCNICO DE PRODUCCIÓN AUDIOVISUAL Cliente: Priscila Bethancourt. Tipo de proyecto: Producción audiovisual explicativa, académica e institucional. 1. OBJETIVO DEL PROYECTO Producir un video resumen de una investigación universitaria sobre las alertas meteorológicas en a. El objetivo es transformar el contenido de la investigación en una pieza audiovisual dinámica, visualmente atractiva y fácil de comprender, que mantenga la atención de los espectadores y permita explicar los principales conceptos, datos y conclusiones del trabajo. No se busca una presentación convencional de diapositivas, sino una producción audiovisual con recursos gráficos, animaciones, infografías y material visual de apoyo. 2. MATERIALES PROPORCIONADOS POR LA CLIENTE La cliente compartió una carpeta de Google Drive con el material de producción: Según lo indicado por la cliente, contiene: 1. Guion: estructura y contenido narrativo del video. 2. Storyboard: referencia visual de las escenas y los elementos que podrían acompañar cada fragmento de la locución. 3. Locución: narración de voz en off que servirá como base para organizar y sincronizar el video. 4. Clips audiovisuales: videos que pueden utilizarse como material complementario en determinadas escenas. 5. Logotipos: recursos de identidad visual para incorporar donde corresponda. La cliente confirma que el storyboard es orientativo y que no es obligatorio reproducir exactamente sus indicaciones. Existe libertad creativa para proponer soluciones visuales que mejoren el resultado. Antes de comenzar: revisar todos los archivos de la carpeta, escuchar la locución completa y estudiar el guion y storyboard. 3. DIRECCIÓN CREATIVA Y ESTILO VISUAL La cliente quiere un video dinámico que mantenga la atención de los espectadores. Se recomienda una estética: - Profesional, moderna e institucional. - Académica, pero visualmente atractiva. - Limpia y organizada. - Con buena jerarquía visual. - Con transiciones fluidas y movimientos naturales. - Con variedad de recursos gráficos para evitar escenas estáticas prolongadas. Se pueden combinar infografías animadas, ilustraciones, mapas, estadísticas, textos, iconos, imágenes y clips reales. La animación debe cumplir una función explicativa, no utilizarse únicamente como decoración. 4. RECURSOS VISUALES QUE DEBE INCLUIR LA PRODUCCIÓN A. Infografías y estadísticas - Representación visual de datos relevantes de la investigación. - Gráficos animados y elementos estadísticos. - Diagramas y esquemas explicativos. - Cifras y conceptos destacados en pantalla. B. Mapas y elementos meteorológicos - Mapas de República Dominicana cuando corresponda. - Representaciones visuales de alertas meteorológicas. - Iconografía relacionada con el clima y los fenómenos meteorológicos. - Elementos gráficos que ayuden a explicar la información geográfica. C. Textos y títulos - Títulos animados. - Palabras clave destacadas. - Textos explicativos breves. - Subtítulos sincronizados con la narración. D. Animaciones y transiciones - Movimientos gráficos fluidos. - Transiciones profesionales. - Animación de elementos visuales. - Composiciones dinámicas que acompañen la explicación. E. Clips y recursos audiovisuales - Aprovechar los videos proporcionados por la cliente cuando sean relevantes. - Incorporar los logotipos suministrados. - Combinar material real con recursos gráficos para enriquecer la narrativa. 5. ESTRUCTURA NARRATIVA La producción debe seguir el guion y la locución proporcionados por la cliente. Como referencia, la narrativa contempla: 1. Introducción y presentación del tema. 2. Contexto de las alertas meteorológicas en República Dominicana. 3. Desarrollo de los aspectos principales de la investigación. 4. Presentación de datos y hallazgos relevantes. 5. Conclusiones y cierre. El orden definitivo debe respetar el guion entregado. No agregar información, estadísticas ni conclusiones que no estén respaldadas por el material de la investigación. 6. AUDIO Y LOCUCIÓN - Utilizar la locución proporcionada por la cliente. - Sincronizar las escenas y animaciones con la narración. - Incorporar música de fondo apropiada para una producción académica e institucional. - Realizar mezcla y nivelación de audio. - Mantener la voz clara y por encima de la música. - Incorporar efectos sonoros sutiles cuando aporten valor. La locución será la guía principal para establecer el ritmo y la duración de las escenas. 7. ESPECIFICACIONES TÉCNICAS - Duración estimada: 2 minutos y 30 segundos a 3 minutos y 30 segundos. - Orientación: horizontal 16:9. - Resolución: 1920 × 1080 píxeles. - Calidad: Full HD. - Formato de entrega: MP4. - Audio: locución, música y mezcla. - Textos: títulos y subtítulos integrados. La duración debe ajustarse al contenido real de la locución y al guion aprobado. 8. ENTREGABLE FINAL Se debe entregar: 1. Video completo en formato MP4 y resolución Full HD. 2. Todas las escenas editadas y ensambladas. 3. Recursos gráficos, infografías y animaciones integrados. 4. Locución sincronizada. 5. Música de fondo y mezcla de audio. 6. Subtítulos integrados. 7. Transiciones y acabado audiovisual profesional. 9. RONDAS DE CORRECCIONES El proyecto contempla dos rondas de ajustes gratuitos: Primera ronda: correcciones generales de textos, escenas, sincronización, gráficos y detalles visuales. Segunda ronda: aplicación de observaciones finales y refinamiento de los elementos previamente corregidos. Las correcciones deben mantenerse dentro del guion, storyboard y alcance acordados. Los cambios sustanciales de concepto, nuevas secciones o ampliaciones importantes del contenido quedan fuera de las revisiones ordinarias. 10. CRITERIOS DE CALIDAD El resultado debe cumplir con lo siguiente: - Mantener la atención del espectador. - Tener una narrativa visual coherente. - Evitar escenas excesivamente estáticas. - Presentar datos e infografías fáciles de comprender. - Utilizar animaciones que refuercen la explicación. - Mantener consistencia gráfica durante todo el video. - Respetar el contenido académico de la investigación. - Garantizar buena sincronización entre imagen y locución. - Tener un acabado profesional apropiado para una presentación universitaria. INSTRUCCIÓN GENERAL PARA EL EDITOR La prioridad es convertir el guion, storyboard y locución de la cliente en un video explicativo de calidad profesional. La cliente no ha establecido ningún software ni técnica de producción obligatoria. El editor tiene libertad para seleccionar las herramientas y los métodos de trabajo que considere más adecuados, siempre que se respete el resultado visual solicitado. Se recomienda dar protagonismo a las infografías, mapas, estadísticas y elementos animados, combinándolos con clips reales y otros recursos visuales cuando corresponda. Importante: no comenzar a producir escenas aisladas sin revisar primero la totalidad de la locución y el storyboard. Es necesario organizar la secuencia completa, identificar qué recurso visual acompañará cada fragmento de audio y mantener una continuidad narrativa de principio a fin."

opportunities.title: Entrevista a Ingenieros Tech Remotos LATINOS
opportunities.description: Título: Entrevista de 1 hora a LATINOS que son Software/Data Engineers latinoamericanos que trabajan remoto en empresas internacionales (USD 20) Descripción: Hola, soy profesor de inglés para ingenieros de software y de datos, y estoy construyendo un programa de inglés especializado para perfiles tech. Para que sea realmente útil, quiero aprender de personas que ya viven este proceso día a día. Busco IA Engineers, Software Engineers, Data Engineers y perfiles afines para una entrevista por videollamada de 1 hora donde conversaremos sobre: - Cómo es el ambiente laboral en una empresa internacional. -Tu experiencia trabajando de forma remota con equipos de otros países Los retos que enfrentas con el inglés en el trabajo (reuniones, daily stand-ups, entrevistas, escritura, Slack, etc.) -Cómo aprendiste inglés y qué te funcionó (y qué no) -Pago: USD 20 por la sesión de 1 hora. Requisitos: -Trabajar actualmente de forma remota para una empresa internacional -Ser ingeniero de software, ingeniero de datos o un rol técnico similar. -Tener un nivel de inglés intermedio o superior Ser latinoamericano, con español como lengua nativa -Tener buena conexión a internet y disponibilidad para una videollamada a través de Freelancer. Cómo funciona: Envías tu propuesta indicando tu rol, tu empresa (o el tipo de empresa) y tu disponibilidad. Coordinamos la sesión por videollamada por Freelancer.com (NO por google meets). Hacemos la entrevista de 1 hora, de forma conversacional. Si tu sesión aporta mucho valor, podría contratarte para sesiones adicionales. Si cumples con los requisitos, ¡eres bienvenido!

opportunities.title: Cold Caller B2B con Español por Comisión -- 2
opportunities.description: Busco alguien ambicioso, que tenga experiencia realizando Cold Calls y quiera hacer dinero. Solo se aceptan candidatos con Español nativo, o con excelente manejo del mismo. Nuestra empresa ofrece servicios de marketing digital, software dedicado y diseño web a otras empresas, por lo que seria ideal que tu cuentes con experiencia B2B. No queremos a un empleado, queremos a alguien se se sume al proyecto y trabaje igual de duro que todos nosotros para que, en equipo, podamos hacer dinero. No recibirás un sueldo ( mientras estes en tu periodo de prueba ) pero si recibirás un 10% de cada venta cerrada por nuestro equipo de closers que TU hayas logrado pasar a WhatsApp, lo que supondría como mínimo, de 100 a 500 dólares por venta para ti, ya que nuestro ticket mas bajo comienza en los $999 y no tiene techo, llegando a poder hacer paquetes de 30k. Esa será tu única tarea, llamar a pequeñas, medianas y grandes empresas hispanas en todo el mundo con la finalidad de llevarlos a WhatsApp, para que nosotros podamos hacerle el appointment Setting. Una vez pases el periodo de prueba, seguidas cobrando en base a comisiones, pero se te añadirá un fijo mensual basado en cuantas llamadas seas capaz de hacer al dia.

opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan bantuan untuk membuat konten promosi yang siap pakai khusus untuk marketplace dan WhatsApp. Targetnya sederhana: begitu konten dipasang, calon pembeli langsung terpikat dan tertarik untuk melakukan order. Ruang lingkup yang saya bayangkan mencakup: • Copywriting singkat, padat, dan persuasif yang cocok untuk deskripsi produk, broadcast WhatsApp, dan chat follow-up. • Desain visual sederhana (gambar atau template) yang mampu menarik perhatian dalam sekali lihat, tetap ringan agar mudah dikirim via WhatsApp maupun di-upload ke marketplace. • Call-to-action jelas yang mendorong klik “Beli Sekarang” atau “Chat Admin”. • Saran penjadwalan dan sudut cerita (angle) agar kampanye terasa segar meski diulang beberapa kali. Saya akan menyediakan info produk, keunggulan, serta foto mentah. Anda meramu semuanya menjadi paket konten promosi siap edar beserta panduan singkat cara menggunakannya. Fokus utama adalah kecepatan eksekusi, bahasa promosi yang natural, dan visual yang tetap profesional meski sederhana. Jika Anda pernah merancang konten serupa untuk marketplace populer atau blast WhatsApp massal, ceritakan hasilnya dan lampirkan contoh agar saya bisa langsung menilai gayanya.

opportunities.title: CAD Design for Car Vent Phone Mount
opportunities.description: Freelance CAD designer needed: turn a concept sheet for a car air-vent phone mount into print-ready 3D files (STEP + STL) for functional 3D printing. The product: a phone holder that clips into a car AC vent WITHOUT touching the vent louvers. Two spring-loaded side legs expand horizontally against the vent housing side walls (rubber pads grip the walls). A ventilated honeycomb backplate (about 60% open area) lets air flow through and behind the phone. Silicone bumpers hold the phone, with minimal built-in tilt (about +/-7 degrees) in the side bumpers. No ball joint, no base. The concept sheet attached shows the front, side cross-section, exploded view, rear view and how it works. Deliverables: - Fully modelled 3D assembly and each part separately (backplate, left and right spring-loaded legs, internal expansion mechanism, bumper holders). - STEP and STL files for every part, print-ready (watertight, correct orientation). - Design for PA12 nylon (SLS/MJF) prototyping. Clearances of 0.3 to 0.5 mm on moving and sliding parts, wall thickness suitable for PA12. - Spring: model a compression spring seat/pocket and recommend a standard off-the-shelf spring size (or a printed flexure alternative if you think it is more reliable). - Parametric source file (Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Onshape or similar) so dimensions can be tweaked after the first test print. - Short note listing assumptions and dimensions to confirm (vent opening width range, phone width range, expansion travel). Please share relevant CAD experience with mechanical or consumer products, spring/snap-fit mechanisms and 3D-printing-ready design, with examples of past work. One round of revisions after the first prototype is expected.

opportunities.title: Smart Wearable Enclosure CAD Redesign
opportunities.description: The current enclosure of my wrist-worn smart device exists as a Fusion 360 assembly, but it still takes too many steps to put together on the bench. Your task is to refine that design so the next revision is straightforward to assemble and friendly to large-scale CNC machining. You will start by reviewing my existing Fusion 360 file, tightening the external form, re-laying internal PCBs, battery and sensors, and adding all mounting, snap-fit or screw bosses needed for a clean mechanical stack-up. My top priority is making the enclosure easier to assemble and manufacture, so every decision—from wall thickness and draft angles to fastener choice—should reflect Design for Manufacturing principles. Once the architecture is locked, I need fully detailed, tolerance-controlled documentation ready for both prototype CNC runs and future production. Deliverables • Fully parametric Autodesk Fusion 360 model of the complete enclosure assembly • CNC-ready 3D geometry and tool-path-friendly bodies • Formal DFM review with notes on machining, finishing and assembly flow • Tolerance-controlled 2D engineering drawings (Fusion 360 + PDF) • Neutral STEP files for downstream CAD and vendor use • PDF package of all finalized drawings and build documentation A background in compact electronics housings, precision mechanical design and production machining will make this go smoothly. If you are comfortable iterating quickly in Fusion 360 and can hand back a clean, organised data set that a CNC shop can quote immediately, we will be an excellent fit.

opportunities.title: Social Media Share / Copy Link Popup
opportunities.description: I need a lightweight, mobile-friendly popup that lets visitors quickly share the current page or copy its URL. The popup should appear when they tap or click a “Share” button I’ll place in my page template. Core requirements • Display recognizable social icons (think Facebook, X, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, Email) alongside a clear “Copy Link” option. • One-click copy should place the canonical URL in the user’s clipboard with a visual confirmation (e.g., “Link copied”). • Opening a social icon should pre-populate the post with the correct page title, description, and image pulled from my existing Open Graph data. • Style must match my site’s color palette and respect dark mode if detected. • Code should be vanilla JavaScript (or a small React component if you prefer), clean CSS, and zero external dependencies beyond the sharing URLs themselves. Deliverables 1. Reusable HTML/JS/CSS (or React) component. 2. Brief setup notes so I can drop it into any page type—blog, product, or landing—without breaking layout. 3. A short testing checklist confirming share links, copy function, and responsiveness on major browsers and iOS/Android. If you’ve built similar widgets, a quick demo link or GIF will help me choose faster.

opportunities.title: Long-Term B2B Outreach Operator – n8n / Make + WhatsApp API + Email (India)
opportunities.description: We are VIMA India Business Desk, based in Nagpur. We need a long-term B2B Campaign Operator and automation expert — not a one-time developer. We have working Excel databases of Indian B2B buyers . They are a solid starting point, but incomplete: some records are missing key contact fields and part of the data needs updating and verification. Cleaning, completing and keeping these lists current is part of the job. PHASE 1 (this fixed-price project): data preparation + technical setup + Month 1 of live operations. 1. DATA PREPARATION: audit our existing lists, remove duplicates and invalid records, verify and complete missing contact fields, and set up a repeatable process to keep the database updated. Tell us in your proposal which tools you use for email verification and data enrichment in the Indian market. 2. SETUP: connect email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp Business API into one outreach funnel using n8n or Make. All infrastructure built under VIMA accounts — you operate it, we own it. 3. DAILY OPERATION: load our lists into the system and run campaigns week by week. 4. LEAD ROUTING: filter the noise and route only qualified leads directly to our local manager in Nagpur. 5. DELIVERABILITY AND COMPLIANCE: manage domain warm-up, sending volumes and WhatsApp template approvals so our domains stay out of spam folders and our WhatsApp number stays in good standing. WHAT WE MEASURE IN MONTH 1 - Percentage of records cleaned, verified and enriched - Emails delivered vs. bounced (target bounce rate under 3%) - Open and reply rate per segment - Number of qualified leads routed to our Nagpur manager - Zero domain blacklisting, zero WhatsApp number restrictions TERMS - VIMA pays for all software licences (n8n, Wati, Meta, LinkedIn tools, verification and enrichment tools). - Data preparation and setup must be completed within 15 working days of project start. - If Month 1 meets the targets above, we move you to a permanent monthly retainer. That is the real opportunity here — we want one operator for the long run. - Preference for candidates in or near Nagpur. Remote across India is acceptable. SELECTION PROCESS Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a short PAID test task (48 hours) before we award the project. We pay for the test whether or not we hire you. SCREENING — READ CAREFULLY Generic bids will be ignored. To be considered, start your proposal with the exact phrase: "VIMA Nagpur Operator" Then answer in no more than 4 sentences total: 1. How do you handle opt-in and template approval when messaging a cold B2B list through the WhatsApp Business API? 2. Name one project where you ran an outreach system continuously for 3 or more months, and what reply rate you achieved. Proposals without the phrase, or without both answers, will not be reviewed.

opportunities.title: Instructor Meta Ads para Curso Online
opportunities.description: Buscamos instructor de Meta Ads para desarrollar y grabar un curso online (básico a avanzado) Estamos buscando una persona con experiencia en Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram Ads) que pueda desarrollar y grabar un curso educativo para nuestra academia. El objetivo es ofrecer a nuestros alumnos una formación práctica y completa que les permita aprender a crear, configurar, administrar y optimizar campañas publicitarias para sus propios negocios. Nuestros alumnos incluyen emprendedores, propietarios de pequeños negocios, profesionales independientes, estudios de belleza, spas y negocios locales que desean aprender a promocionar sus servicios mediante publicidad digital. ¿Qué necesitamos? Una persona que pueda: - Desarrollar un programa de formación desde nivel básico hasta avanzado. - Explicar paso a paso cómo utilizar el Administrador de anuncios de Meta. - Enseñar a crear campañas desde cero para Facebook e Instagram. - Explicar los objetivos de campaña, públicos, segmentación y presupuestos. - Enseñar a configurar anuncios, imágenes, videos y textos publicitarios. - Explicar cómo utilizar WhatsApp como destino para captar clientes. - Enseñar a revisar resultados, métricas y optimizar campañas. - Explicar cómo organizar campañas y administrar diferentes cuentas publicitarias. - Incluir ejemplos prácticos enfocados en pequeños negocios y servicios locales. Requisitos del instructor: - Experiencia demostrable trabajando con Meta Ads. - Capacidad para enseñar de manera clara, organizada y sencilla. - Hablar español. - Contar con equipo adecuado para grabar clases (micrófono, computadora y buena calidad de audio y video). - Tener conocimientos para grabar tutoriales de pantalla y explicar los procedimientos paso a paso. - Poder entregar las clases grabadas y organizadas por módulos. Modalidad del proyecto: Buscamos desarrollar un curso autograbado, dividido en módulos y lecciones, para que los alumnos puedan acceder al contenido y avanzar a su propio ritmo. Presupuesto: Actualmente no tenemos un presupuesto fijo establecido. Nos gustaría conocer las propuestas económicas de los interesados. Si estás interesado, puedes dejarnos en los comentarios tu presupuesto aproximado, una breve descripción de tu experiencia y algún ejemplo de cursos o trabajos que hayas realizado. Posteriormente, nos pondremos en contacto para explicar mejor el proyecto, definir el contenido, la cantidad de módulos, los entregables y acordar una estructura de pago. Le dejamos una pequeña referencia en imagen ¡Esperamos conocer tu propuesta!

opportunities.title: Telugu-English Learning Cartoons Creation
opportunities.description: I’m getting ready to launch “Happy Kids World” and need a creative partner to produce a series of short Telugu-and-English cartoons that help young children aged 5–7 master their letters, numbers, and first words. Each video should balance clear educational moments with the colour and energy that keeps kids giggling, singing along, and—most importantly—learning. You’ll handle the full pipeline—concept, script, voice-over (both languages), animation, sound, and final mastering—so our channel can upload finished episodes on a consistent schedule. The visual style should feel warm, friendly, and easy for children to follow; think bright characters, simple shapes, and lots of repetition that reinforces the alphabet and counting without ever feeling like homework. When you reply, focus on your experience creating educational or children’s animation. Links to completed projects that show bilingual content, early-literacy themes, or a comparable art style will help me see the fit quickly. If you have a preferred workflow or toolset (Toon Boom, Adobe Animate, Blender, After Effects, etc.), mention it so we can align on files and formats from day one. I’m excited to build a long-term collaboration that keeps kids around the world learning, laughing, and playing—starting right here in both Telugu and English.

opportunities.title: Selenium Gmail Email Automation
opportunities.description: I need a concise Selenium-based solution that automatically sends emails from my Gmail / Google Workspace account. The goal is to replicate the exact user flow—log in, compose, attach (when provided), and send—so I can fire off routine messages without manual clicks. Your script should handle authentication securely, respect 2-Step Verification or App Passwords if they are active, and finish by confirming that the “Message sent” toast appears. I’m comfortable running the script in Python, so please structure the code and virtual-env requirements for that stack. Clear inline comments, a short README, and a sample JSON or CSV payload for dynamic subject/body placeholders will make testing easy on my side. I’ll consider the task complete once I can: • Execute a single command that launches the browser, signs in, composes, and sends. • See verification that Gmail accepted the email or receive the sent copy in my inbox. • Swap in my own recipient list and template text without editing core logic. If you rely on additional libraries—Selenium WebDriver, webdriver-manager, dotenv, etc.—note the versions so environments stay in sync.

opportunities.title: Script Python Aviator para Google Sheets
opportunities.description: TÍTULO: Python Script - Coletar Histórico Público Aviator para Google Sheets CATEGORIA: Python / Web Scraping / Google Sheets API ORÇAMENTO: $10 - $50 USD (Vou premiar por $30) DESCRIÇÃO: Preciso de um script em Python simples, código aberto, para coletar histórico público e salvar no Google Sheets. Sem aposta, sem login, sem automação de jogo. O QUE PRECISO (Marco 1): 1. Script em Python (.py) que rode no meu PC (Windows). 2. O script deve ler o histórico público de multiplicadores que aparece na tela (últimas 50 rodadas) a cada 60 segundos. 3. Salvar automaticamente em uma aba chamada Historico_Aviator no Google Sheets com 3 colunas: Data/Hora | Multiplicador | ID da Rodada 4. Não pode duplicar rodadas que já foram salvas. 5. Arquivo README.txt explicando passo a passo como instalar e rodar (pip install, como criar a chave do Google). 6. Vídeo de 2 minutos mostrando o script rodando na sua máquina e atualizando o Sheets. 7. Profissional com experiência comprovada em "bots Aviator" e/ou automações relacionadas a sites de apostas para fornecer orientações profissionais sobre o projeto e sugerir melhorias adicionais. REGRAS OBRIGATÓRIAS: 1. Código 100% aberto e comentado. Não aceito .exe, .apk ou código ofuscado. 2. Não pode fazer login na casa de aposta, não pode clicar em apostar, não pode automatizar aposta. 3. Pagamento SOMENTE por marco dentro do Freelancer. Não pago por WhatsApp, USDT. PRAZO: 3 dias após premiar. PARA SE CANDIDATAR, RESPONDA ISSO NA SUA PROPOSTA (se não responder, ignoro): Qual biblioteca Python você usaria para pegar os dados e por quê? Responda em 2 linhas.

opportunities.title: Full-Stack Developer Needed –Membership Portal & Dashboard Integration (Laravel)
opportunities.description: We are seeking an experienced full-stack developer to design and develop a complete, secure, database-driven membership portal and personalized member dashboard for our website. An existing membership database is available, but the member dashboard and portal must be developed from scratch in Laravel. Project Requirements: 1. Dashboard Design & Development: Design and build a modern, professional, mobile-responsive member dashboard consistent with AAPSCM® branding. 2. Membership Registration: Develop a secure online registration, account activation, and login system for existing members. 3. Member Identity Verification: Integrate the existing membership database to authenticate members using their membership IDs or certificate IDs, with appropriate identity verification. 4. Account & Password Management: Allow verified members to create personal accounts with secure passwords, mandatory password changes every 30 days, and password recovery functionality. 5. Automated Profile Population: Automatically retrieve and display each member's personal information, professional details, membership category, status, and expiration dates from the existing database. 6. Certification Integration: Connect certification records to individual member accounts and automatically display earned certifications, certificate IDs, issue dates, expiration dates, and digital credentials. 7. Dashboard Modules: Develop functional sections for Dashboard Overview, Membership, My Profile, Certifications, Orders, Exams, Training & Learning, Events & Webinars, Chapters & Communities, Resources & Publications, and Account Settings. 8. Administrative Management: Develop an administrative interface for managing member accounts, certifications, membership status, resources, and access permissions. 9. Database Integration & Automation: Integrate existing membership records with the new portal and enable automatic synchronization of relevant member information. 10. Security & Access Control: Implement secure authentication, role-based permissions, member-specific data protection, and appropriate cybersecurity safeguards. 11. Testing & Deployment: Conduct complete system testing, resolve technical issues, deploy the portal, and provide technical documentation. Required Expertise: Full-stack web development, PHP/Laravel or compatible technologies, MySQL, API integration, UI/UX design, database management, and secure membership management systems. Bidders must provide: Examples of similar completed projects, proposed development approach, estimated completion timeline, and a fixed-price quotation. Fee: $2,000 (Maximum deadline - 3-4 weeks)

opportunities.title: Cinematic 3BHK Interior Walkthrough Design
opportunities.description: I’m looking for an original interior design for my 1,883 sq ft, 3BHK apartment in Bengaluru. Propose one distinctive theme that suits the attached floor plan and brings the whole home together. I’d like it to feel warm, spacious and cinematic, with practical materials and lighting for everyday family life. What goes where (as shown on the floor plan) * Entrance and front living room: Welcoming seating for guests. * Kitchen and utility: The builder has agreed to remove the kitchen divider. Design an open kitchen for daily Indian cooking, a two-seat breakfast counter and a practical laundry and drying area. * Former dining area: Keep it open for everyday use. Allow space for a folding table when we host one other family. * Balcony-side family lounge: Our main TV and relaxation area. Keep the route to the balcony clear. * Wood-floored bedroom, bottom right: Master bedroom with wardrobe storage. * Bedroom immediately to the right as you enter, top left on the plan: Daughter’s room with a study area and storage. * Bottom-left room: Home office, Instagram studio and gym. opportunities.title: Odoo–WhatsApp API Connector
opportunities.description: I need a seamless bridge between my Odoo Online database and the WhatsApp Business API so every customer conversation flows directly into Odoo. The integration must let me: • send and receive one-to-one WhatsApp messages from within Odoo’s Discuss/Live Chat views • trigger automatic WhatsApp notifications when an order is confirmed, shipped, or an invoice is posted and paid • turn any incoming chat into a new CRM lead or a Helpdesk ticket, complete with message history and customer contact details Because I am on Odoo Online, the solution has to work without custom server access—either by relying on Meta’s Cloud API endpoints or routing through a provider like Twilio or 360dialog. If you have a preferred method, outline it along with any webhook or middleware you propose. Deliverables 1. A ready-to-install Odoo Online app or external middleware with clear setup instructions 2. Mapping of order and invoice events to message templates, including placeholders for order number, amount, and tracking link 3. Lead/ticket creation logic with field mapping (name, phone, message body, channel) 4. Short video or screenshots showing the three core flows working end-to-end in my sandbox database 5. Post-deployment support for initial testing and template approval with Meta Acceptance criteria: messages move in real time, no duplicate records are created in Odoo, and outgoing notifications are logged under the relevant order or invoice.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40818023, publicado hace 2 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Realistic 3D Character Showcase
opportunities.description: I’m producing a hyper-realistic 3D short movie designed purely as a cinematic visual showcase. The entire narrative will orbit around a single, lifelike human character whose facial nuance, skin detail, and natural movement must stand up to extreme close-ups and dramatic lighting. Scope of work • Complete character pipeline—sculpting, retopology, texturing (Substance Painter or equivalent), hair & groom, clothing simulation, and photoreal shading. • Full animation pass: subtle idle motions through to expressive facial performance, motion-captured or key-framed as you see fit, but it must feel entirely natural. • Cinematic lighting, depth-of-field work, and physically accurate rendering in either Unreal Engine 5, Blender Cycles, Arnold, or another production-grade renderer that you prefer. • Final edit and color-grade delivered as a short film (under a few minutes) in 4K, along with all project files. Acceptance criteria 1. Skin pores, micro-details, and eye shaders remain crisp at 4K close-ups. 2. Cloth and hair react believably to subtle movements and simulated wind. 3. Lighting, lens choices, and camera moves convey a polished, theatrical mood. 4. Final render is free of flicker, noise, or geometry pops. Share any relevant reels or stills that prove your strength with hyper-realistic human work, and briefly outline the tools you intend to use so I know the pipeline you’re most comfortable with. Let’s push visual fidelity as far as current tools allow.

opportunities.title: Freelance Sales Agent for Real Estate Automation – Commission per Closed Client (Remote, Worldwide)
opportunities.description: SmartAutomate (www.smartautomate.in) helps real estate builders, developers and agencies convert more of their leads into site visits and sales. What we do for clients: • Capture leads from property portals (99acres, MagicBricks, Housing.com), Meta and Google Ads, websites and WhatsApp • Reply to every enquiry on WhatsApp within a minute, 24×7 • Ask buyers about budget, BHK and location using AI • Book site visits automatically and send reminders • Send every lead to the client’s CRM and alert their sales team Most real estate businesses lose buyers because they reply late. A buyer enquires with 3–4 projects at once, and whoever replies first usually wins the site visit. That’s the problem we solve. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR A freelancer who can find real estate clients and book demo calls with them. You are not limited to India: you can bring clients from the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the UK, the USA, Canada, Australia, Singapore or any other country. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES • Find builders, developers, real estate agencies and channel partners who get leads from portals, ads or websites • Research them on LinkedIn, Google Maps, property portals and ad libraries • Reach out through LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, phone calls or your own network • Explain our service in simple words and book a demo call with the owner, director or sales head • Follow up with interested prospects • Update every lead in a shared Google Sheet WHAT WE HANDLE • The demo call, the proposal and the pricing discussion • The complete setup and delivery for the client • Support for you on every deal PAYMENT (COMMISSION PER CLOSED CLIENT) • India: project size ₹1.5 lakh → you earn ₹10,000 • Outside India: project size US$3,000 – US$10,000 → you earn ₹15,000 + 5% of the project value • Example: a US$5,000 project → you earn ₹15,000 + US$250 • A client counts as closed when they sign up and make their first payment • Paid within 7 days of the client’s payment • No limit on how many clients you can bring REQUIREMENTS • Good English communication; Hindi or Arabic is a plus • Confident talking to business owners and senior managers • Experience in B2B sales, lead generation, appointment setting or real estate (preferred) • A real estate network or contacts are a big advantage • Honest and professional: no spam, bulk messages or fake promises RULES • Register each lead in the shared sheet first so it’s counted as yours • Don’t promise prices, discounts or results without our approval TO APPLY, TELL US: Which country or city can you find clients in? Your sales or real estate experience, briefly Your LinkedIn profile SKILLS Lead Generation, B2B Sales, Business Development, Appointment Setting, Cold Outreach, LinkedIn Outreach, Real Estate, Client Acquisition BUDGET / PAYMENT TYPE Commission-based: ₹10,000 (India) or ₹15,000 + 5% of the project value (international) per closed client PROJECT DURATION Ongoing / long-term EXPERIENCE LEVEL Intermediate LOCATION Remote, worldwide (freelancers from any country can apply)

opportunities.title: Odoo–WhatsApp Business API Integration
opportunities.description: I run Odoo and want every payment-related conversation with customers to happen on WhatsApp without forcing my team to jump between apps. The goal is an end-to-end integration that: • Lets staff open any invoice in Odoo, fire off a manual WhatsApp message, and see the full chat thread right there on the customer record. • Sends scheduled, automatic payment reminders before and after the due date, while still allowing ad-hoc follow-ups from the same thread. • Logs each outgoing and incoming message as an Odoo activity so nothing slips through the cracks. You may connect through Meta’s own Cloud API, Twilio, or another approved WhatsApp Business API gateway—as long as it stays fully compliant with Meta’s template rules and scales with our future volume. My Odoo is already live, so your work will include the custom module, configuration of webhook callbacks, a simple settings page for templates, and short user documentation. A test database and WhatsApp sandbox can be provided if needed. Deliverable is a clean, installable Odoo module plus a brief hand-over call where we trigger both an automatic reminder and a manual message to prove everything works.

opportunities.title: Google Forms to Sheets Automation
opportunities.description: I have a Google Form collecting customer information and one key multiple-choice field that lets the respondent pick a category or service. I want every submission to land in a Google Sheet automatically, but instead of piling into one big table, each response must appear in its own service-specific tab. If the form offers “Web Design,” “SEO,” or “Content Writing,” a row should go straight into the matching tab; if the category hasn’t been used before, the script should create the tab on the fly. Please build the workflow entirely inside Google Workspace—Apps Script, the Form-to-Sheet link, or any lightweight add-on that stays under my ownership—so there’s no reliance on outside servers or paid third-party platforms. Deliverables • A working script (or add-on setup) that saves every new form submission to the Sheet and routes it to the correct tab based on the selected category/service. • Clear inline comments plus a brief setup guide so I can tweak field names or tab logic later. • Proof of functionality: screenshots or a short screen-recording showing test submissions flowing into their respective tabs. Acceptance criteria • Each form response arrives in the Sheet instantly. • Rows appear in the tab whose name matches the chosen category/service; new categories create new tabs automatically. • Original timestamps and response IDs remain intact. Let me know your timeline and any quick questions—once it’s tested and documented, we’re done.

opportunities.title: Comercial Servicios Tecnológicos Navarra
opportunities.description: En Nafarsare (Pamplona-Iruña) ayudamos a pymes, autónomos y asociaciones de toda Navarra, y sobre todo de zonas rurales, a ordenar su parte tecnológica. Hacemos páginas web, soporte informático, automatizaciones y apps de gestión a medida sobre Google Sheets: control de socios, cobros, reservas, inventario… Buscamos comerciales autónomos que nos presenten a negocios y entidades que puedan necesitarnos. Qué harás Detectar empresas, comercios y asociaciones con procesos manuales (Excel, papel, WhatsApp…) Hacer el primer contacto y conseguir una reunión o un presupuesto [Opcional: acompañar en la reunión o cerrar la venta] Qué ofrecemos 10 % de comisión sobre cada proyecto vendido, pagado al cobrar el cliente. 5 % recurrente durante 12 meses en los servicios con cuota mensual (mantenimiento, soporte, hosting) Formación sobre nuestros servicios, argumentario, casos reales y apoyo técnico en las reuniones Libertad total de horario y 100 % remoto, con reuniones presenciales opcionales en Navarra Colaboración mercantil, sin exclusividad Qué buscamos Experiencia en venta B2B o una buena red de contactos en Navarra (gestorías, comercios, asociaciones, ayuntamientos…) Se valorará el euskera Alta como autónomo o posibilidad de facturar Si te interesa, escríbenos a info@ nafarsare.com contándonos tu experiencia y qué tipo de clientes conoces.

opportunities.title: Build Tulsi Beautique’s Premium Digital Brand
opportunities.description: # PROJECT BRIEF – COMPLETE BRANDING & DIGITAL MARKETING FOR TULSI BEAUTIQUE ## 1. About the Business Business Name: Tulsi Beautique Business Category: Premium Women's Custom Tailoring & Boutique Business Location: Nikol, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India Target Market: Ahmedabad, Gujarat Brand Positioning: Premium, elegant, professional and customer-focused. Brand Language: English and Gujarati. Tagline: "Where Every Stitch Creates Your Style." Tulsi Beautique is a home-based premium women's tailoring business. We want to transform our existing tailoring work into a professionally established boutique brand with a strong online presence. Customers bring their own fabric and raw materials, and we stitch customized outfits according to their individual body measurements, preferences and design requirements. Our objective is to build a trusted boutique brand, attract new customers through Google and social media, and generate genuine business enquiries. ## 2. Main Services Our primary services include: 1. Designer Blouse Stitching 2. Customized Ladies Dress Stitching 3. Traditional Chaniya Choli Stitching 4. Customized Ethnic Wear 5. Personalized Garment Fitting Our focus is on premium stitching quality, accurate fitting, elegant designs, neat finishing and personalized customer service. ## 3. Project Requirements We are looking for a freelancer or digital marketing professional who can handle the complete branding and online business setup. ### A. Complete Brand Identity - Create a premium and elegant logo for Tulsi Beautique. - Develop a professional brand identity. - Suggest suitable brand colors, preferably elegant maroon, champagne gold and ivory. - Select professional fonts and typography. - Create a brand tagline. - Prepare business card design. - Design a professional letterhead. - Create a digital visiting card. - Provide editable source files and high-resolution logo files. The brand should look premium, feminine, modern and trustworthy. ### B. Google Business Profile Setup and Local SEO Create and professionally optimize a Google Business Profile for Tulsi Beautique, subject to Google's eligibility requirements. Requirements: - Business profile setup. - Correct business name and relevant business category. - Business description optimized for local SEO. - Service listings. - Relevant search keywords. - Phone number and business timings. - Location and map pin configuration. - Profile logo and cover images. - Upload genuine business photographs. - Review and reputation management guidance. - Google Maps visibility optimization. Target search keywords: - Ladies Tailor in Nikol Ahmedabad - Designer Blouse Stitching Ahmedabad - Blouse Stitching in Nikol - Chaniya Choli Stitching Ahmedabad - Ladies Dress Stitching Ahmedabad - Premium Boutique in Ahmedabad - Custom Ladies Tailoring Ahmedabad Important: This is a home-based business where customers visit by appointment. Please configure the location and address according to Google's current guidelines. Do not publish the residential address without confirming eligibility and the owner's approval. ### C. Instagram Business Account Setup Create and optimize a professional Instagram Business Account. Requirements: - Instagram account setup. - Professional username. - Attractive profile picture using the brand logo. - SEO-friendly Instagram bio. - Contact and WhatsApp integration. - Instagram Highlights design. - Branded post templates. - Reel cover templates. - Story templates. Suggested Instagram Highlights: - Designer Blouses - Dresses - Chaniya Choli - Our Work - Customer Reviews - Contact Us Initial content requirements: - 9 professionally designed Instagram posts. - 5 Instagram Reel concepts. - 5 Instagram Story templates. - Content captions in English and Gujarati. - Relevant hashtags and local keywords. Use our actual stitching work and product photographs wherever possible. ### D. WhatsApp Business Setup - Create and configure a professional WhatsApp Business profile. - Add business logo, description, location and working hours. - Set up greeting and away messages. - Create service catalogue. - Add enquiry and appointment quick replies. - Create a professional WhatsApp contact link. - Design a QR code for customer enquiries. ### E. Website Development We would also like a modern, mobile-friendly boutique website. Suggested pages: 1. Home 2. About Us 3. Our Services 4. Designer Blouse Gallery 5. Dress Stitching Gallery 6. Chaniya Choli Gallery 7. Contact Us Website requirements: - Premium and elegant design. - Mobile responsive layout. - Basic technical SEO. - Local SEO optimization. - WhatsApp enquiry button. - Click-to-call functionality. - Google Maps integration, where appropriate. - Contact/enquiry form. - Fast loading speed. - Easy content management. The website should focus on generating customer enquiries rather than online payments. ### F. Digital Marketing and Lead Generation Develop a practical marketing strategy to generate genuine enquiries from women across Ahmedabad. Requirements: - Local SEO strategy. - Instagram content strategy. - Google Business Profile updates. - Local audience targeting. - Instagram and Facebook advertising strategy. - WhatsApp enquiry generation. - Monthly content calendar. - Lead tracking and performance reporting. If paid advertising is recommended, please provide a separate estimate for advertising management fees and advertising budget. ## 4. Target Audience Our target customers include: - Women looking for premium blouse stitching. - Women looking for customized ethnic wear. - Women preparing outfits for weddings and festivals. - Customers looking for Chaniya Choli stitching. - Women who prefer personalized fitting and customized designs. - Customers across Ahmedabad. Our primary focus is on Nikol and surrounding areas, with the objective of expanding our reach across Ahmedabad. ## 5. Design Preferences We want Tulsi Beautique to have a premium boutique identity. Preferred visual direction: - Elegant and luxurious. - Feminine and sophisticated. - Minimal and modern. - Premium typography. - Maroon, champagne gold and ivory color palette. - Professional fashion and tailoring imagery. Avoid cheap-looking designs, excessive decorations and generic templates. ## 6. Expected Deliverables Please provide a complete project quotation covering: 1. Logo and brand identity. 2. Google Business Profile setup and optimization. 3. Local SEO setup. 4. Instagram account setup. 5. Initial social media creatives. 6. WhatsApp Business setup. 7. Website design and development. 8. Basic SEO implementation. 9. Digital marketing strategy. 10. Lead generation strategy. Please mention separately: - One-time setup charges. - Monthly maintenance charges. - Website hosting and domain charges. - Social media management charges. - Advertising management fees. - Advertising budget. - Any additional charges. ## 7. Important Working Conditions - All accounts must be created in the business owner's name and under the owner's control. - The owner must have full administrative access to Google, Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp and website accounts. - All passwords and recovery details must remain under the owner's control. - All logo designs, creatives and website source files must be handed over. - No fake reviews, misleading business information or unethical SEO techniques. - All content and designs must be approved by the owner before publishing. ## 8. Project Objective Our long-term vision is to establish Tulsi Beautique as a recognizable premium women's boutique brand in Ahmedabad. We are not looking for just a logo or a social media page. We want a complete professional digital presence that builds brand trust, improves Google visibility, showcases our stitching work and consistently generates genuine customer enquiries. Please review the complete requirements and share: 1. Your proposed execution strategy. 2. Your portfolio of similar boutique or fashion projects. 3. Complete quotation with deliverables. 4. Estimated project completion timeline. 5. Monthly maintenance and marketing charges. We are looking for a professional freelancer who can work with us for the long term as our digital branding and marketing partner.

opportunities.title: Character workout Animation
opportunities.description: I need a short, lively 3D clip that brings a playful cartoon character to life. The sequence is simple: the character enters, walks a few steps, bursts into a fun dance, finishes with a quick fighting pose, and exits. No dialogue—just energetic, exaggerated body language with classic squash-and-stretch timing. You’ll receive a model sheet, reference beats, and a rough storyboard. If you have a suitable rig, great; otherwise please rig the mesh I supply. Blender or Maya is fine as long as the final scene and assets open cleanly on my end. Deliverables • Rigged character file (Blender . blend or Maya . mb) • 15–20-second animation clip (source scene + 1080p MP4 render with alpha) • One revision pass after I review the first draft Acceptance criteria • Silhouette reads clearly in every key pose • No foot sliding or intersecting geometry • Colors and lighting match the reference palette Keep polycount moderate for web/social use and ensure all textures are original or royalty-free. Let me know your usual turnaround and link me to at least one previous piece that showcases a strong walk, dance, or fight cycle. I’m ready to get started as soon as I see work that matches the vibe I’m after.

opportunities.title: Instagram & Facebook Brand Growth - 14/11/2026 05:44 EST

You’ll bring the creative polish, analytics know-how, and reliability to keep the schedule humming even when I’m busy elsewhere in the business. If this sounds like the kind of partnership you enjoy, tell me a little about similar local campaigns you’ve managed and the results you achieved. I’m ready to get started as soon as we agree on the first month’s plan.

opportunities.title: Commission-Based Software Sales Partner
opportunities.description: Independent Sales Partner – 20% Commission per Closed Deal We are a software engineering and design company helping businesses build custom software, automate workflows, integrate AI, and improve their existing applications. We're looking to partner with independent sales professionals who can connect us with businesses that need these services. What you'd be doing - Finding businesses that need custom software development, AI integration, workflow automation, or improvements to their existing applications (through your network, LinkedIn, outbound outreach, or any approach that works for you). - Connecting with business owners, founders, decision-makers, and relevant stakeholders. - Arranging introductory calls with our team and staying involved throughout the sales process until the deal is closed. - Building relationships that can lead to long-term business opportunities. We handle the technical discussions, requirement analysis, project scoping, proposals, negotiations on the technical side, and complete project delivery. You don't need to be technical. You just need to be comfortable communicating with business owners, decision-makers, and potential clients. What you earn - 20% commission on every project you successfully bring in and help close. - Your earnings depend on the value of the projects you close, with no upper limit on your commission. - Commission is paid as we receive payments from the client, subject to the agreed payment arrangement. - Opportunities for continued commissions on additional projects from clients you bring in, subject to mutual agreement. There is no fixed salary, no minimum working-hour requirement, and no cap on your earnings. You earn based on the business you bring to us. You'd be a great fit if - You have experience in B2B sales, business development, or client acquisition. - Ideally, you've sold software development, IT services, SaaS, digital agency, or technology consulting services. - You have access to a network of business owners, startup founders, or decision-makers, or know how to reach them. - You're confident in prospecting, initiating conversations, building relationships, and closing deals. - You're comfortable working independently on a commission-only basis and are interested in building a long-term business partnership.

opportunities.title: Unreal Engine Digital Twin Artist
opportunities.description: We are seeking a senior 3D artist/digital generalist with demonstrable experience in Unreal Engine 5, MetaHuman (or Character Creator), and AI-assisted facial animation. The role involves developing a hyper-realistic virtual artist—a "digital twin"—for a professional music project focused on bachata and Latin music. Phase 1 of the project includes the following key deliverables: 1. Creation and rigging of a hyper-realistic male digital twin: The character must be 6 feet tall and feature a cinematic, lifelike human aesthetic—based on reference photos provided by the client—avoiding any anime or fantasy-style elements. 2. Setup of a lip-sync and facial expression capture pipeline: Implementation of tools such as Audio2Face, Live Link Face, or similar solutions is required to ensure the character can sing and gesture in Spanish with complete naturalness and emotional realism. 3. Development or adaptation of a photorealistic virtual environment: Creation of an initial virtual setting—such as a recording studio or radio booth—that complements the project's aesthetic. Mandatory requirements for applicants: - Submission of a portfolio or case studies demonstrating experience in creating hyper-realistic human faces and lip-syncing. - Availability to complete a paid test milestone—a short, 5–10 second render validating the face and lip movement—prior to the full production of six music videos. - Ability to maintain fluid communication in Spanish, working toward clear objectives and defined deliverables.

opportunities.title: Inventory management for my small ecommerce site (wordpress), website is not live yet
opportunities.description: I run a small-scale ecommerce site and keep every SKU’s quantity inside the website’s own admin panel. What I am missing is an automatic way to keep those numbers in sync with real-time sales activity. Here is what I need built and fully tested: • Whenever a product is purchased, the system must instantly deduct the sold units from the on-hand quantity. • As soon as a product’s count reaches zero, it should switch to “Out of Stock” status on the storefront so customers can’t buy what I don’t have. All updates come from— and write back to— the same internal inventory database; no supplier feeds, POS integrations, or external spreadsheets are involved. The final solution should slot neatly into my existing admin workflow, require minimal manual upkeep, and include clear setup notes so I can maintain or adjust it later. If you have experience developing inventory automation for ecommerce platforms (custom PHP, WooCommerce, Shopify apps, or similar), I’d love to see a quick outline of your approach and a rough delivery timeline.

opportunities.title: 5-inch Human Figure 3D Model
opportunities.description: I have a single reference photo of a person and I need it turned into a 5-inch 3D printable figure. The finished file must capture a highly realistic likeness with fine surface detail, and the full-body pose and proportions must match the photo exactly. Please sculpt, retopologize, and deliver a watertight file ready for FDM or SLA printing (STL or OBJ preferred). Keep wall thicknesses and overhangs print-friendly for a figure that will scale to 5 inches tall without losing detail. I will provide the image once we start; feel free to ask for any extra angles you might need before sculpting. When you send the final file I’ll run a quick mesh integrity check and slice preview—once it passes without errors, the job is complete.

opportunities.title: Python Developer for Automated SEO Site Audit & Competitor Scraper
opportunities.description: Our manual SEO audit and competitor research workflows are taking too long to scale. I need a Python developer with practical SEO knowledge to build an automated script that audits our target websites and flags critical on-page issues in minutes instead of hours. The Problem to Solve: We need to automatically crawl a list of URLs (both our site and competitors'), extract key on-page SEO data, identify technical errors, and output an easy-to-read action report. Key Deliverables: Automated Crawler: A Python script (using Requests, BeautifulSoup, or Scrapy) that crawls given domains or sitemaps without getting blocked. On-Page Audit Extraction: Pull and flag missing or duplicate title tags, meta descriptions, H1s, broken links (404s), and slow-loading pages. Competitor Keyword & Content Check: Extract top-used keywords and word counts from competitor URLs for side-by-side comparison. opportunities.title: Odoo E-Commerce Store with AI Search
opportunities.description: I want a clean, visually appealing, minimalistic, fast e-commerce site built entirely with Odoo’s in-house Website Builder and hosted on my Odoo domain—this point is not negotiable. The store structure is simple: Home, Shop (all products live here), Contact Us and a Wholesale page that contains an enquiry form. The Website should SEO Optimization, Google Indexing, Competitor Analysis, Keyword search analysis, Meta Ads, Google Business Set Up. Integration with Chat GPT/Google Gemini for quick query resolution. AI Chat bot if customer is stuck anywhere It also needs to integrate with Google Workspaces for which backend set up is necessary Core integrations - WhatsApp Business – when a shopper taps the WhatsApp icon on any product page it must open a chat window pre-filled with that product’s name or link so they can message me instantly. - Instagram – a header or footer icon should take visitors straight to our profile. - Payment & shipping connectors are already configured at the backend, so the storefront only needs to surface them cleanly at checkout. Search by image Customers should be able to: 1. Upload a photo from their device, 2. Take a photo with their camera, or 3. Pick any image already on the site, and receive visually similar product results inside the Shop page. Wholesale enquiry form The form must capture: Name, Business Name, E-Mail, Phone Number, Product Interest and Expected Quantity, and route the submission to my inbox. After-go-live hand-over Please document (or record a short Loom) showing how I can add or edit products from the Odoo backend later. Clarify what level of post-launch support you provide for bug fixes and minor updates. Deliverables • Fully functional Odoo website with the four pages above, mobile-responsive design and live links to Instagram/WhatsApp • Image search feature operating as described • Wholesale form storing all requested fields and sending notifications • Clear, step-by-step guide for future product updates • Two weeks of post-launch bug-fix support (or let me know your alternative) If you have recent Odoo e-commerce builds to showcase, share them so I can see your approach. I’m ready to start as soon as we agree on scope and timeline.

opportunities.title: Enterprise AI Animated Background Design
opportunities.description: Forge is a new Claude-powered AI platform, and its landing page needs a single, standout animated background created directly in Figma. The rest of the UI is already in place; this job focuses only on that hero-section backdrop. Visual direction • Overall look: futuristic, enterprise-grade, with abstract AI-inspired motion that instantly signals innovation without feeling playful or game-like. • Colour mood: dark-to-midnight tones accented by discreet neon pulses or gradient blooms, so headings and CTAs remain legible. • Motion style: smooth, cinematic loops rather than fast or distracting movements. Exact elements—whether flowing data lines, glowing nodes, subtle digital grids, or soft 3D geometry—are flexible; I’ll rely on your judgement to choose what suits the composition best while keeping the file lightweight for web. Deliverables 1. Figma file with the complete layered design, component naming kept tidy. 2. Defined animation specs (timings, easing, loop behaviour) in Figma’s prototype panel or an attached note. If you prefer Lottie or lightweight video export, include the linkage instructions. 3. A brief hand-off guide outlining colour values, motion FPS, and any implementation tips for React / Tailwind integration. Acceptance criteria • Background scales cleanly from 1440 px desktop down to 360 px mobile without cropping key visuals. • Loop is seamless for at least 15 seconds and keeps CPU/GPU usage moderate. • Final file delivered within the agreed Figma project link and also as .fig downloadable copy. If anything is unclear or you need brand colours, let me know and I’ll share the current style guide right away.

opportunities.title: 2D Kinetic Typography & Technical Motion Graphics Designer (After Effects) — Corporate Product Launch Video
opportunities.description: We are looking for a skilled 2D Motion Graphics Designer (Adobe After Effects) to produce a sharp, 76-second kinetic typography and technical product showcase video for our product. We will provide: A 76-second reference video ( corporate motion-graphics style) showing the exact pacing, color wipes, split-screen metrics, wireframe line reveals, and kinetic typography rhythm we want to replicate. A complete frame-by-frame storyboard & script with exact timings and copy. High-resolution static product renders and brand assets. Strict Production Rules: Manual Animation vs. Static Assets (Read Carefully) To maintain crisp corporate precision and ensure our final video does not trigger automated "AI Info / AI-Generated" labels on Instagram, YouTube, or LinkedIn, our workflow strictly separates static assets from video animation: 1. What MUST Be 100% Manually Animated (No Generative AI Video): Zero AI Video Generators: Do not use Runway, Kling, Sora, Pika, Luma, HeyGen, or AI video templates to generate clips or transitions. Manual Keyframing in After Effects: All kinetic typography, full-screen color wipes, rolling number counters, animated UI toggles, particle text dissolves, and glowing CAD/wireframe line draws must be built manually using native After Effects shape layers, text animators, and keyframes. Clean Export Pipeline: Export the final MP4 with standard H.264 encoding and Content Credentials / C2PA AI metadata disabled so no editing-tool AI flags are embedded in the container. 2. Where Static AI-Assisted Assets Are Permitted (and How to Handle Them): Static Product Renders & Cutouts: You will receive our approved product renders (and may use Photoshop/Illustrator to clean up edges, create vector wireframe outlines of the chassis, or isolate transparent PNG cutouts). Metadata Hygiene on Static Assets: If you use any AI-assisted cleanup or upscaling on static product PNGs, you must flatten/rasterize and strip metadata (export as clean PNG/PSD without C2PA Content Credentials) before importing them into After Effects, so Adobe software does not propagate an "AI-assisted" tag into the final video render.

opportunities.title: PESO-Compliant LNG Station Layout
opportunities.description: I’m starting paperwork for a brand-new LNG filling station and I need an experienced architect-draftsman who not only understands PESO regulations inside out but can also put a professional signature on the drawings for submission to the authorities. The immediate task is a complete site layout that shows every piece of equipment, all safety distances, and any other details required for fresh-station approval. You’ll be preparing the full set in CAD—AutoCAD or equivalent—so it is ready for PESO scrutiny. Accuracy against the latest rules is essential; the inspector must see at a glance that tank positioning, setback distances, vent stacks, emergency access, and pedestrian/vehicle flows are exactly where they need to be. Beyond this first submission, I’m looking to keep the same professional involved as the project moves through revisions, construction drawings, and future station rollouts, so think of this as the start of an ongoing collaboration. If you can certify your own work, quote the relevant clauses while drafting, and turn feedback around quickly, let’s talk.

opportunities.title: Compressed Bio Gas Plant Mechanical Engineering
opportunities.description: I’m putting together a full design package for a green-field biogas facility that will process more than 50 t/day of Napier grass (or similar energy crops) and upgrade the gas to >90 % pure Bio-CNG. To move from concept to construction I need a process engineer—or a small interdisciplinary team—to translate my production targets into a fully engineered solution that can be handed straight to EPC contractors and automation vendors. The scope begins with the biology. I will supply rough feed analyses; you will calculate the organic loading rate, hydraulic retention time, expected gas yield, nutrient balance, and mixing power for a continuously stirred tank reactor (CSTR) train. From those figures we’ll finalise digester volume, agitation duty, heating loops, and any necessary feed pre-treatment. Once the raw biogas numbers are set, the job expands into purification. Please size and specify an economical PSA, water-scrubbing, or membrane system—your choice, so long as it consistently strips CO₂, H₂S, and moisture to reach the 90 % + methane spec. Utility demands, media consumption, and expected skid footprints have to be part of the package. Mechanical and instrumentation detail is essential. I need complete PFDs and P&IDs, line lists, datasheets for slurry pumps, heat exchangers, flare, blowers, flow meters, analysers, and safety valves. Every piece should close out a mass- and energy-balance so the numbers reconcile. Because the plant will run largely unattended, a high-level PLC/SCADA narrative is also required. Describe temperature control loops, pH and pressure interlocks, emergency shutdown logic, and the commissioning sequence needed to start the biology safely the first time. Deliverables (all native files plus PDFs): • Block flow diagram, PFD, heat & material balance • P&IDs with annotated equipment and instrument tags • Equipment sizing calculations and datasheets • Gas upgrading package sizing and vendor recommendations • Control philosophy and PLC/SCADA I/O list • Commissioning and biological start-up plan Drawings can be produced in AutoCAD P&ID or similar; calculations in Excel, ASPEN, or your preferred process software, as long as assumptions are transparent. If you’ve taken at least one large-scale digester from design through commissioning, especially with fibrous energy crops, I’d like to see that experience reflected in your proposal along with a rough timeline to first draft.

opportunities.title: Modern Snack Packaging Concept
opportunities.description: I need a premium, contemporary packaging concept for a new line of indulgent snacks and sweets. The design must instantly signal quality while feeling fresh and minimalist enough to appeal to trend-conscious shoppers. Think clean typography, tactile finishes, and a color palette that hints at flavor without overwhelming the eye. Scope of work • Develop a memorable visual story that can scale across individual SKUs. • Supply at least three distinct concept directions, each shown on a printable dieline and as shelf-ready 3D mock-ups. • Refine the chosen route into final, print-ready artwork (CMYK + spot where needed) delivered in Adobe Illustrator formats, with linked files and font outlines intact. • Provide a short rationale explaining material choices (eco-friendly substrates preferred) and how the design supports food-safety labeling regulations. Acceptance criteria • Artwork fits the supplied dieline precisely, with clear zones for legally required nutrition data. • Geometry and folds preview accurately in the 3D render. • Color values remain within printable gamut; mock-ups display realistic finish effects (matte, soft-touch, or foil). When you respond, highlight similar snack or confectionery packaging you have created and outline the experience that makes you confident tackling premium food brands. A concise portfolio link is perfect; no formal proposal deck needed at this stage.

opportunities.title: Reflective Awning CAD Model Creation
opportunities.description: I need a detailed 3D CAD model of the solar awnings, which are wall-mounted tensile structures measuring 4 m by 3 m, deliberately oriented South-Southeast to maximize solar irradiance and establish a worst-case thermal loading baseline during summer testing. The experimental setup isolates the radiative heat transfer capabilities of two specific coated polyester-thread textiles. The control is a standard white textile (Sw) featuring a PVC-based coating that yields a 76% solar reflectance and a high long-wave infrared emissivity of 0.87. The engineered solution is a low-emissivity textile (Le) utilizing an asymmetric, double-faced design. Its upward-facing surface maintains a 70% solar reflectance and 0.87 emissivity to reject short-wave solar radiation, while its downward-facing surface utilizes an aluminum-based coating that drastically drops infrared emissivity to 0.37. By explicitly orienting this aluminum layer toward the ground, the textile acts as a radiant barrier that restricts the awning from re-radiating absorbed thermal energy downward into the pedestrian zone. For ease of use, I would like the native file in SolidWorks plus a neutral exchange format such as STEP or FBX, along with a quick viewport screenshot confirming the UV layout. If you can supply a clay and a fully textured render from your software, that helps me confirm we’re looking at the same result. Deliverables • 1 fully modelled Wall-mounted awning • PBR material setup showing reflective, high-resistance polyester • Native file in SolidWorks + neutral export (STEP/FBX) • Two simple verification renders (clay & textured) Once the files import cleanly and the material reacts to my test HDRI as expected, the job is complete.

The control is a standard white textile (Sw) featuring a PVC-based coating that yields a 76% solar reflectance and a high long-wave infrared emissivity of 0.87. The engineered solution is a low-emissivity textile (Le) utilizing an asymmetric, double-faced design. Its upward-facing surface maintains a 70% solar reflectance and 0.87 emissivity to reject short-wave solar radiation, while its downward-facing surface utilizes an aluminum-based coating that drastically drops infrared emissivity to 0.37. By explicitly orienting this aluminum layer toward the ground, the textile acts as a radiant barrier that restricts the awning from re-radiating absorbed thermal energy downward into the pedestrian zone.
